# my-skill

<Capability tier only — a floor-tier skill needs no README. Keep this under 30 lines.>

**Needs:** `systems.<flag>` (<the system, in generic terms>); facts `<system>.<kind> <name>` (<what for>).

**Without it:** prints `my-skill: not applicable here — <flag> is false` and stops. Nothing else changes.

**Example:**

> **user:** <what the user asks>
>
> **claude:** <the one-line result, or the handoff artefact it wrote>
